ابتهجن (form VIII)
# اِبْتَهَجْنَ (ibtahajna) /ib.ta.had͡ʒ.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِبْتَهَجَ (ibtahaja)
# اُبْتُهِجْنَ (ubtuhijna) /ub.tu.hid͡ʒ.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِبْتَهَجَ (ibtahaja)
# اِبْتَهِجْنَ (ibtahijna) /ib.ta.hid͡ʒ.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِبْتَهَجَ (ibtahaja)
